description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

MACOM is seeking a Software Engineer to develop software tools and automation solutions that improve engineering and operational efficiency. The role focuses on automating workflows, building data-processing and analysis tools, integrating applications with engineering systems, and applying AI technologies to semiconductor engineering and manufacturing challenges.
Production Software Development Engineer building Python automation and data tools, integrating engineering systems and APIs

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain software tools and automation solutions to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency
• Build Python-based applications, scripts, and utilities to automate repetitive engineering tasks and workflows
• Develop tools for data processing, analysis, visualization, and reporting using engineering and manufacturing data
• Work with product, test, validation, manufacturing, and other engineering teams to identify opportunities for process and workflow automation
• Integrate applications with databases, APIs, engineering systems, test equipment, and internal tools
• Apply Generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents where appropriate to improve engineering workflows and productivity
• Test, debug, validate, and maintain internally developed software tools
• Improve existing tools based on user feedback and changing engineering requirements
• Document software, workflows, test results, and technical solutions
• Apply software engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, testing, modular design, and maintainable code

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
• 0–3 years of professional experience in software development, engineering automation, data analysis, or a related technical field. Relevant internships, academicprojects, and research experience are welcome
• Strong programming skills in Python
• Experience with data processing and analysis using libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or similar tools
• Basic understanding of databases, SQL, APIs, and software integration
• Familiarity with Git or other version-control systems
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to understand engineering workflows and translate user requirements into practical software solutions
• Ability to learn new technologies and work effectively with engineers from different technical disciplines
• Good written and verbal communication skills
• Experience developing engineering automation tools, internal applications, dashboards, or data-analysis utilities
• Experience with Python GUI or web application development
• Familiarity with SQL, databases, REST APIs, and data pipelines
• Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, or AI application development
• Experience automating laboratory or test equipment using interfaces such as GPIB, USB, LAN, or serial communication
• Familiarity with engineering data visualization and statistical analysis
• Personal, academic, internship, or open-source projects demonstrating practical software development and automation skills
• Interest in applying software and automation to semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, validation, manufacturing, and data analysis

Preferred:
• Experience with semiconductor engineering, manufacturing, or test environments
